restaurantName: Afternoon Tea at the Kingsley Hotel
bio: Treat yourself to a quintessential Afternoon Tea in Kingsley Two Brasserie, at The Kingsley by Thistle. Indulge in a range of traditional delights in this charming Edwardian hotel located in the heart of the West End, before exploring the must-see London landmarks.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Kingsley Two Brasserie, a pleasant and welcoming dining area. With a mellow colour scheme, soft feature lighting and large arched windows, the Kingsley Two Brasserie is the ideal location to leisurely enjoy a Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at Thistle Kingsley is a sophisticated balance of sweet and savoury- traditional finger sandwiches and sausage rolls are followed by a selection of dainty desserts and scones with clotted cream. For those feeling particularly decadent, add a glass of Pimm's, a glass of Sparkling Wine or a Rose Royale cocktail.  Located in the heart of The West End, The Kingsley is within walking distance of definitive London landmarks such as Covent Garden and the British Museum.
pageTitle: Afternoon Tea at the Kingsley Hotel
